mode_inference_decision.rationale: Opaque existing licensed GLB ground surface; deterministic mesh alignment and interpolation of approved material factors.

source.geometry: User-authorized original Blender environment; existing V5 ground inside accepted V7 perimeter bundle.
source.license: Existing verified Poly Haven Cobblestone Pavement CC0 maps; no new source art.

processing.geometry: Close the 12 mm gaps of the existing 12 by 14 four-meter slabs. Align shared positions and UVs without adding or removing triangles. Preserve indices, normals, node transforms and non-ground geometry.
processing.color: Linear glTF tint interpolation: u=gx/12, v=gz/14. Existing ground0/1/2 factors receive weights (0.30+0.25u, 0.40-0.25u-0.10v, 0.30+0.10v). This affine field has no diagonal gradient folds or repeating cell islands. Other ground vertices retain their original material factors.
processing.encoding: Append FLOAT VEC3 COLOR_0; append FLOAT ground POSITION/TEXCOORD_0 only for slab-containing primitives. Preserve every original BIN byte and original accessor/bufferView; no compact or whole-scene re-export.
processing.texture_policy: All image bytes, PBR fields except four ground factors, texture density 2.5 m, UV orientation, indices, normal accessors, nodes and collision bounds remain unchanged.
processing.budget: Same 75,368 triangles and 35 primitives; zero new textures/materials/draws. Under 30 KB GLB growth. Extra vertex attribute and shader variant have nonzero cost, to be measured after visual acceptance.

scope_note: Finite ground continuity repair only. Does not establish CS2 parity, solve repeated cobblestone photography, fix hands or prove frame-presentation latency.

performance_gate.validity: hardware D3D11, real move/turn/fire/aim/reload, no pause/hidden/context or page error/HMR contamination
performance_gate.limits: Non-regression evidence for this sampled workload only; no causal speedup or presentation-latency claim.
